assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for content and design discussion; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted geometry uses the repository provisional site boundary and key-area polygons (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: Areas, ratios, and spatial conclusions are directional only; recalculate after official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: No parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are made; the proposal provides a classification method pending official building inventory and ownership data.
assumptions.impact: Renewal project list and building footprints are concept proposals, not approved demolition or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer community operations, scenario opening, and international outreach mechanisms are concept proposals for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government arrangements, investment commitments, or approved operational plans.
